app.name: Is It AI Generated?
app.tagline: Detect AI text and AI images in your browser
app.description: Free, ad-free AI detector. Everything runs on your device: your text and images never leave your browser.
verdictDesc.likelyHuman: Mostly human signals with a few formulaic spots.
verdictDesc.uncertain: Mixed signals. Too little text, or a blend of styles.
verdictDesc.likelyAI: Several patterns typical of language models.
text.title: AI text detector
text.lead: Paste text to see a per-sentence AI index and the exact patterns behind it. Nothing is uploaded.
text.placeholder: Paste or type your text here…
text.tooShort: Add a bit more text for a reliable result.
image.title: AI image detector
image.lead: Check provenance metadata and pixel statistics locally. The image is never uploaded.
image.drop: Drop an image here, or click to browse
image.privacy: The file is read in your browser only.
counter.title: Word counter
counter.lead: Counts, reading time, keyword density and readability, updated as you type.
slop.title: Slop detector
slop.lead: Find the writing patterns AI models over-produce, with quotes and fixes. Based on the no-ai-slop and stop-slop rules.
compare.title: Compare two texts
compare.lead: Find near-duplicate wording between two passages, locally.
stats.title: Site statistics
stats.lead: Aggregate, anonymous usage of this site.
stats.privacy: Privacy-first: no cookies, no fingerprinting, no personal data stored. Visits are counted with a daily rotating hash that is discarded immediately.
stats.optout: You have opted out of anonymous statistics on this device.
api.title: Use it as an API
api.lead: The same engine is available as a REST endpoint, an npm package and a CLI.
about.title: About and privacy
about.privacyText: Text and images are processed entirely in your browser. Nothing is uploaded for analysis. There are no ads, no trackers and no third-party scripts. The only network request is the anonymous aggregate counter, which respects Do Not Track and Global Privacy Control and can be disabled.
about.openText: The full source is on GitHub under the MIT licence. The detection engine is a dependency-free module you can reuse in your own projects.
about.limitsText: This is a heuristic index, not proof. It measures style, not authorship. Short texts are unreliable, and any detector can be wrong on edited or mixed content. Never use it as the only evidence in a decision about a person.
footer.madeWith: Made with no ads, no tracking and no nonsense.
hero.title: Check if text or an image was made by AI
empty.text: Paste text to see the AI index, the evidence behind it and where it changes sentence by sentence.
empty.image: Drop an image to read its Content Credentials, generator signatures and pixel statistics.
evidence.title: Evidence
evidence.noneDetail: No invisible characters, homoglyphs or watermark reading. The score below rests on style and statistics alone.
unicode.hiddenDetail: Invisible Unicode tag characters encode a message that is not visible in the text.
watermark.title: Statistical watermark
watermark.noKey: No key supplied. SynthID-Text and green-list detection need the provider key, which is not public. Supply your own key to verify text you watermarked.
c2pa.title: Content Credentials (C2PA)
c2pa.absentDetail: Editing, converting or screenshotting a file removes its manifest. Its absence proves nothing.
provenance.notConfigured: OpenAI key not configured on this deployment. Local C2PA parsing already ran.
image.notImage: That file is not an image.
slop.catalogNote: Phrase, character and emoji tells, scored by density and variety. Kept separate because curly quotes and non-breaking spaces are normal in many languages.
image.verdictDesc.unknown: Nothing to go on yet. Run the on-device model.
image.verdictDesc.real: The classifier reads this as a real photo.
image.verdictDesc.unsure: The classifier is not confident either way.
image.verdictDesc.likelyAi: The classifier leans toward AI generation.
image.verdictDesc.noEvidence: Metadata was stripped, so only a model run can say more.
image.surfaceNote: Informational only. These numbers do not decide the verdict.
model.hint: Cross-generator ViT, 23 MB, downloaded once then cached in your browser.
